celica1_2
Derby, United Kingdom33 contributions
0
Judge for yourself
Nov 2025 • Couples
We visited here a few times while in the area. The pizzas are nice but on the 2nd visit it got weird. I ordered mozzarella/ham pizza. When it arrived on the table from the wood fired oven, the topping was cold. Apparently it’s common to serve pizza with cold toppings, I was told! This made the pizza base soggy and inedible. It went back to be exchanged for a pasta dish, that came out on the smallest bowl they could find in the kitchen! The pasta was under cooked, not seasoned and the bolognese was very salty. When I asked to pay the bill, I was ignored. It seems that if you don’t like the food here or comment, you are made to feel uncomfortable so we left after paying an expensive bill for food that didn’t deliver. The manager tried to tell me they make the best food, as we left but unfortunately I will leave it to the community of TP. If you’re in the area give it a go. You might enjoy your food. Domino’s doesn’t do cold pizza toppings. Disappointed on this occasion.
Read more
Written November 18, 2025
Lance L
Celica, I am very sorry to read this story and for sure the Pizza should be hot. Please understand though that our method of preparation is authentic Italian so its not Dominos in Derby, however, even in Italy the pizzas are served hot so my apologies for that.
As for the pasta, it is always cooked 'al dente' very important part of Italian popular culture. In France and UK we tend to cook it to the time indicated on the pack which, by Italian standards is too much. In SE Asia the noodles are cooked to death, a ig challenge when training local crew.
The Manager was correct, we do make the best Italian food in Hoi An/Da Nang but it seems in your case we 'dropped the ball' and for that I am truly sorry.
Your next meal is on me if you are inn the area and my profound apologies once more. This was not, for you, a typical day at La Riva-Lance. ( also disappointed)

Great Fine Italian Food Right Here in Hoi An!!
Jun 2025 • Friends
I'm always on the lookout for fine food... Found it!!!

I met up with some friends for a "Fare-The-Well' dinner & drinks, and discovered Great, Fine, Food, right here in Hoi An!!

We started at the bar where the bartenders and staff greeted us with a smile and served us ice cold beers, pastisse, and wine!! Was pleased that the presentation was top notch, the coasters were replaced when wet, and our orders were promptly served!!

When we moved to the table, the staff took over and moved our drinks and tab to the table (hahaha... most places make you close out the bar tab!! These people do it right; easily and painlessly!!)

We ordered three pizzas, and all were beautiful and delicious; right out of the wood-fired oven!!

Lance had the (I can't remember) Pizza, Kev had the Steak Pizza, and I had the Meatlover's Pizza (mine was unforgettable!!) The Napolitano - Style pizza was outstanding... in a class by itself... beautiful soft and flavorful crust, delicate, tangy sauce, tasty mozzarella, and heaps of meats; the way it should be for carnivores!! One of the finest pizzas I've ever had (inlcuding in Italy & Napoli!!). It was a struggle to not eat the last two slices; brought 'em home to my honey for her to enjoy!!

The table service was also detailed and attentive. Great staff!!

(PS The owners came by to say hello; Very very nice people, Jessica & Alessandro (yup; Italian!... guess that's why it's soooo goood!)

Definitely a place I'll be visiting again, WITH my family!!! ... SOON!!

Bon Apetito!!!

reviews.review_text:
Traveller S
5 contributions

Only Your Money Matters Here
Mar 2025 • Couples
If only I could give zero out of five…

A review according to Oxford: 
‘a formal assessment or examination of something with the possibility or intention of instituting change if necessary.’ 

I can’t imagine this restaurant taking any review to heart judging by the DISMAL customer service experience I had. It had nothing to do with food, poor waiting staff, or long waiting times to eat.

There is a raw sewage smell that permeates the whole restaurant, so they use fans to redirect the smell. It happened to be blowing the smell directly at us so I went to nudge it in another direction. Not knowing the fan was faulty and precariously held together, I was cut quite severely on 2 fingers. I quietly informed a staff member, held my hand under my dripping injury and made my way to the WC, leaving a trail of blood behind me. Here I was given one bandaid or plaster, a little bit of disinfectant and told I was ok.

In the meantime, our food was delivered to the table, so now cold. My partner had to cut my food, thus making both meals even colder. 

Not once did a manager come to apologize, ask if I needed more help, or even enquire if I was all right. 

We ate, asked for the bill, paid, and again, ZERO acknowledgement of the incident.

Restaurant 101 - the customer is the most important part of your business. Without them, you don’t have a business. At minimum, a dessert should have been offered as an apology, but I would have preferred an actual apology.

So, upon review, there is definitely the need to institute some change. If this is what they believe to be good customer service, I shudder to think what their standards are for hygiene and safe cooking.
Read more
Written March 17, 2025
Lance L
I'm sorry but I didn't get your name.
Firstly, we have the cleanest and most hygienic kitchen possible. This is not my first Rodeo and I previously owned one of the most popular and famous restaurants in the Caribbean for 9 years with 12 TripAdvisor awards.
There are many points you have raised so let me respond point by point:

Firstly, the odor you may have experienced is not a product of La Riva. This is a direct result of the drains in the street, (we have 2 in front of us), the weather, i.e.hot days and the local street vendors annoying habit of pouring dirty dish water and refuse into the drains. Its their country, their culture and while we try to guide it to everybodies benefit, tourism is seeing something different right!
When it gets strong we normally cover the drains outside so there is no exhaust from it. The placement of the fans was clearly our mistake and their placement just seems to have exasperated the problem. Unfortunately, rather than have us move you to another location within the restaurant you decided to take things into your own hands ( so to speak), resulting in your injury for which we are truly sorry.
Fortunately we had the medical kit to patch you up, the fact that your food arrived while you were being tended to is just unfortunate timing.
While I appreciate that your injury was a priority of you, the manager had many other customer to deal with which is not to excuse, I was not here this occasion but maybe we should have compt your meal and sent you to the hospital. Our manager is not a Doctor.
FYI From : Restaurant Owner 101; the customer may NOT always be right but they ARE always the customer!
Had you, in the beginning, made my staff aware of the issue instead of trying to resolve it yourself this might all have been avoided.
Thank you for bringing this to my attention, this is how we learn-Lance
